articles.author: Ladislav Hagara
articles.description:
Byl vydán Linux Mint 22.3 s kódovým jménem Zena. Podrobnosti v přehledu novinek a poznámkách k vydání. Vypíchnout lze, že
nástroj Systémová hlášení (System Reports) získal mnoho nových funkcí a byl přejmenován na Informace o systému (System Information). Linux Mint 22.3 bude podporován do roku 2029.
articles.title: Linux Mint 22.3 Zena

articles.author: Ladislav Hagara
articles.description: Wine bylo po roce vývoje od vydání verze 10.0 vydáno v nové stabilní verzi 11.0. Přehled novinek na GitLabu. Vypíchnuta je podpora NTSYNC a dokončení architektury WoW64.
articles.title: Wine 11.0

articles.author: Ladislav Hagara
articles.description: Byl vydán Mozilla Firefox 147.0. Přehled novinek v poznámkách k vydání a poznámkách k vydání pro vývojáře. Firefox nově podporuje Freedesktop.org XDG Base Directory Specification. Řešeny jsou rovněž bezpečnostní chyby. Nový Firefox 147 bude brzy k dispozici také na Flathubu a Snapcraftu.
articles.title: Firefox 147.0

articles.author: NUKE GAZA! 🎆
articles.description: Asociace repair.org udělila anticeny těm nejhorším produktům představeným na veletrhu CES 2026. Oceněnými jsou například šmírující kamery Amazon Ring AI, chytrý běžecký pás od společnosti Merach, která otevřeně přiznává, že nedokáže zabezpečit osobní data uživatelů, případně jednorázové lízátko, které rozvibrovává čelisti uživatele a tak přehrává hudbu. Absolutním vítězem je lednička od Samsungu, která zobrazuje reklamy a kterou lze otevřít pouze hlasovým příkazem přes cloudovou službu.
articles.title: To nejhorší z veletrhu CES

articles.author: NUKE GAZA! 🎆
articles.description: Íránští protirežimní aktivisté si všímají 30% až 80% ztráty packetů při komunikaci se satelity služby Starlink. Mohlo by se jednat o vedlejší důsledek rušení GPS, kterou pozemní přijímače Starlinku používají k výpočtu polohy satelitů a kterou se režim rovněž snaží blokovat, podle bezpečnostního experta a iranisty Amira Rashidiho je ale pravděpodobnější příčinou terestrické rušení přímo satelitní komunikace Starlinku podobnou technologií, kterou islamistická teokracie již v minulosti použila pro rušení příjmu signálu satelitní televize. Írán je už od 8. ledna odpojen od Internetu, což je v této zemi během protestů obvyklé.
articles.title: Írán ruší signál satelitů Starlink

articles.author: Ladislav Hagara
articles.description: Evropská komise (EK) zvažuje, že zařadí komunikační službu WhatsApp americké společnosti Meta mezi velké internetové platformy, které podléhají přísnější regulaci podle unijního nařízení o digitálních službách (DSA). Firmy s více než 45 miliony uživatelů jsou podle DSA považovány za velmi velké on-line platformy (Very Large Online Platforms; VLOP) a podléhají přísnějším pravidlům EU pro internetový obsah. Pravidla po provozovatelích těchto platforem vyžadují, aby se více snažili bojovat proti nelegálnímu a škodlivému obsahu a také proti padělaným výrobkům nabízeným na svých platformách. Cílem komise je přezkoumat, co jsou vlastně soukromé zprávy, které do působnosti DSA nespadají, a co jsou otevřené kanály, které fungují spíše jako platformy sociálních médií. Ty do působnosti DSA spadají.
articles.title: Brusel zvažuje, že zařadí WhatsApp mezi platformy podléhající větší regulaci

articles.author: Ladislav Hagara
articles.description: Tržní hodnota technologické společnosti Alphabet poprvé v historii přesáhla čtyři biliony dolarů (83 bilionů Kč). Stalo se tak poté, co Apple oznámil, že bude na poli umělé inteligence (AI) spolupracovat s dceřinou firmou Alphabetu, společností Google.
articles.title: Hodnota Alphabetu přesáhla čtyři biliony dolarů po oznámení, že Apple bude v oblasti AI spolupracovat s Googlem

EA Sports has announced a new maintenance for FC 26 that will take place today across all platforms, and it will heavily impact online connectivity.


This is the first major maintenance in the new year, and it comes ahead of the TOTY celebrations. Thankfully, EA Sports has announced the complete schedule that will allow you to keep track of when the servers will be down.


FC 26 server maintenance details (Jan. 14)


The servers will go down before the maintenance actually begins. Today's maintenance starts 11pm ET/1am CT/2am ET/7am UTC across all platforms. Older titles like FC 25 will also be down when the maintenance is live. Matchmaking will go down 30 minutes before the actual maintenance begins.


The maintenance is scheduled to last for five hours. Unless there are delays, the maintenance should be over by 4am ET/6am CT/7am ET/12am UTC. That said, there can always be delays during maintenance. If that happens, I will duly add the updated timings to this guide.




Once the matchmaking is disabled, all forms of online games will be out of order. Modes like Ultimate Team will also become inaccessible. You should still be able to enjoy content on the Web app and Companion app. However, logging in via your PC/console should be disabled. Even if you manage to get in, trying to start a fresh match will result in an error.


It will be interesting to find out if EA Sports will be making any live tuning upgrades during the maintenance. The last major patch, Title Update 1.4.0, came out earlier in January, and it made some heavy changes to AI-defending and movement.


Of course, this maintenance might be in preparation for the upcoming TOTY promo. We already have confirmed dates about when the promo begins and which players are going to feature on the starting lineups.

The quest begins at the start of day 10 when the major briefs you about what needs to be done. When you're in the early game, there's not much you can do with a zombie in Quarantine. However, this quest will introduce you to the Cage in the Laboratory.


Image via Devolver Digital


The Cage can contain an undead and allow you to study for research. You'll find the Cage to the right of the main lab tent (from where you can discover new symptoms). Your next task is to feed the zombie. Head straight from the lab gates, and you'll end up in front of the locked zombie. 


How to feed the zombie in Hi, Doggy quest


Image via Devolver Digital


This task is pretty simple. Go to the Liquidation zone, where you send the infected to be chopped. You'll find a marked area by the pile of bags. Pick up a body bag, put it on the card, and go back to the laboratory tent. If you can't pick up the body, chances are that the cart isn't close enough. Interact with the cart and bring it closer to the body bags. 


Image via Devolver Digital


Park the cart next to the Cage, and interact with the body bag carrying the corpse. Pick it up, and put it in the Cage, and the zombie will start to eat. This will complete the Hi, Doggy quest. Make sure to put the cart in the highlighted zone so that the corpse can be fed to the zombie trapped inside.

Ready for another adventure? Hytale is here in early access for PC, and the survival crafting game is a ton of fun.


Like Minecraft before it, Hytale is a first-person adventure, but you can also play it in third-person by switching things up in the menus. Unlike Minecraft, though, it's not a simple button switch to change your camera angle.


Here's how to swap your camera angle and play Hytale in third person.


How to play Hytale in third person


Image via Hypixel Studios


Hytale, by default, is played in first-person perspective. But you can swap to third-person perspective in-game so that you can see your character and all the awesome gear you worked hard for. 


To change perspective:



Press ESC and open up Settings.


Navigate to Gameplay.


Scroll down to Camera, and select Camera Preference (On Spawn). 

This will allow you to swap between First Person or Third Person (with an option to Remember Last Used), which will take effect when you respawn.





Screenshot by Destructoid


In order for the change to take place, you need to save your settings and either log out of the game and log back in or respawn at your bed. Once done, you should be able to see your new perspective in-game. Have fun!

One of the crucial early-game items in Hytale is Rubble, because it's used in crafting all sorts of items including Crude Tools that you need to begin your journey to riches and combat glory. Talk about your humble beginnings!


Before you can craft Adamantite or Mithril swords and pickaxes, it all begins with Rubble. Here's how to get Rubble in Hytale.


Where to find Rubble in Hytale


Look for the little grey stones. Screenshot by Destructoid


Rubble is found scattered all over the ground in Hytale, but you just have to know what you're looking for. The image above shows exactly what Stone Rubble looks like, and you must interact with it to pick it up (F on keyboard by default).


When crafting recipes call for "Any Rubble," any kind of Rubble will do. So far, it seems like Stone Rubble is the most common, so keep your eyes on the ground and spam the F key to pick up Rubble as you walk over it to add it to your collection. I found a ton of Rubble on the ground while walking around the immediate area where I spawned in my own world.


With Rubble, you can craft a number of the basic early items in the game, such as:



Campfire


Crude Sword


Crude Pickaxe


Crude Hatchet



These items will all help you when starting out in your quest, so make sure to pick up Rubble if you come across it in your journey to find the best spot to build your home.

Groupon, the global marketplace that aims to offer users some of the best online deals, recently featured an offer that was too good to be true. After Dutch anti-piracy group BREIN flagged an illegal IPTV service on the platform, Groupon reportedly took swift action to remove it. BREIN credits this rapid response to its new 'Trusted Flagger' status under the EU’s Digital Services Act (DSA).
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Groupon ‘Redeems’ Itself With Rapid Takedown of Pirate IPTV Deal

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
Pornhub parent company Aylo has won its copyright infringement lawsuit against PornXP, securing a $10.2 million damages award against its Kyrgyzstani operator. The court also ordered domain registries to disable and transfer the PornXP domains to Aylo. However, since domain registrars are not mentioned in the court order, PorkBun refused to take action, which meant that Aylo had to go back to court.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Court Orders Porkbun and Other Registrars to Hand Over PornXP Domains to Aylo

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
The High Court in New Delhi, India, has granted another pirate site blocking order in favor of American movie industry giants, including Apple, Warner., Netflix, Disney and Crunchyroll. The injunction targets notorious pirate sites, requesting blockades at Indian ISPs. More crucially, however, globally operating domain registrars, including U.S. companies, are also compelled to take action. However, despite earlier cooperation, most don't seem eager to comply.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Disney, Netflix & Crunchyroll Try to Take Pirate Sites Down Globally Through Indian Court

From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Top 10 Most Pirated Movies of The Week – 01/12/2026

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
Elon Musk's X Corp. filed a landmark antitrust complaint against the NMPA, Sony, Universal, and other major music publishers, claiming that they used a coordinated "extortionate campaign" to force licensing deals. The lawsuit alleges that a flood of "baseless" DMCA notices targeted over 200,000 posts and suspended 50,000 users, allegedly to coerce X to sign industry-wide agreements.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: X Sues Music Publishers Over “Weaponized” DMCA Takedown Conspiracy

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
Italy’s communications regulator AGCOM imposed a record-breaking €14.2 million fine on Cloudflare after the company failed to implement the required piracy blocking measures. Cloudflare argued that filtering its global 1.1.1.1 DNS resolver would be "impossible" without hurting overall performance. AGCOM disagreed, noting that Cloudflare is not necessarily a neutral intermediary either.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Italy Fines Cloudflare €14 Million for Refusing to Block Pirate Sites on Public 1.1.1.1 DNS (Update)

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
The Paris Judicial Court has ordered Google to block nineteen additional pirate site domains through its public DNS resolver. The blockade was requested by Canal+ and aims to stop pirate streams of Champions League games. In its defense, Google argued that rightsholders should target intermediaries higher up the chain first, such as Cloudflare's CDN, but the court rejected that.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: French Court Orders Google DNS to Block Pirate Sites, Dismisses ‘Cloudflare-First’ Defense

From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.

Popular shadow library Anna's Archive has lost control over its main domain name. Annas-archive.org was suspended and put on serverHold status, which is an action that's typically taken by the domain name registry. The site's operator doesn't believe that the actions are related to its recently announced Spotify backup and stresses that the site remains accessible through alternative domains. 
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Anna’s Archive Loses .Org Domain After Surprise Suspension (Update, .Se Too)

From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.

From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.

From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Strike 3’s Piracy Litigation Campaign Broke More Records in 2025

USN-7927-1 fixed vulnerabilities in urllib3. The update for CVE-2025-66471
introduced a regression in urllib3 when decompressing zstd data. This
update fixes the problem.

We apologize for the inconvenience.

Original advisory details:

 Illia Volochii discovered that urllib3 did not limit the steps in a
 decompression chain. An attacker could possibly use this issue to cause
 urllib3 to use excessive resources, causing a denial of service.
 (CVE-2025-66418)

 Rui Xi discovered that urllib3 incorrectly handled highly compressed data.
 An attacker could possibly use this issue to cause urllib3 to use
 excessive resources, causing a denial of service. This issue only affected
 Ubuntu 24.04 LTS, Ubuntu 25.04, and Ubuntu 25.10. (CVE-2025-66471)

 security update in the brotli package.
